title: In-Place Home Resale Re-Inspection Booking Payment
content:
**Booking terms — re-inspection of an In-Place Home Resale home.** A re-inspection of a resale file is booked when the seller makes the booking payment on the file, a payment that clears every fee then owed on the file and prepays the visit fee of the coming re-inspection; the visit fee is charged on the visit date and is met from that prepayment.

## Booking conditions

The booking payment is fixed only after the file's ledger carries the inspection charge owed for every initial inspection recorded on the file.

The booking payment is not worked out until the file's ledger carries the vacant-home check charge owed for every calendar month in which the occupancy recorded on the file has stood vacant.

| The file's ledger carries the inspection charge owed for every initial inspection recorded on the file | The file's ledger carries the vacant-home check charge owed for every calendar month the recorded occupancy has stood vacant | Booking payment |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | may be worked out and fixed |
| no | either | not yet fixed |
| either | no | not yet worked out |

## Invocation

The payment is made with `pay_reinspection_booking_26088ed0`, a tool owned by the seller: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to pay on their own resale file on the spot. One payment is recorded as received today on the file's ledger through the channel chosen, a processor confirmation number is issued for it, and the fees owed on the file fall by the amount; a figure below zero is a credit held on the file.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `resale_id` | the resale file number of the seller's home, as read to the seller from the in-place resale file lookup | identifier text |
| `amount` | the payment amount, in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; recorded exactly as passed |
| `payment_channel` | how the payment is made | one of the five values below |

| `payment_channel` value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `online_portal_ach` | the seller pays from a bank account through the resident portal |
| `online_portal_card` | the seller pays with a debit or credit card through the resident portal |
| `office_money_order` | the seller hands a money order to the community office |
| `office_cashiers_check` | the seller hands a cashier's check to the community office |
| `office_personal_check` | the seller hands a personal check to the community office |

## Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of these fields: `status` (the text "paid"), `resale_entry_id` (reference number of the new ledger payment), `resale_id` (the file credited), `entry_date` (date received, YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (the payment in USD with 2 decimal places), `payment_channel` (the channel used), `payment_ref` (the processor confirmation number issued for this payment) and `fees_balance` (the fees owed on the file net of this payment, USD with 2 decimal places; below zero means a credit is held). The tool defines no other receipt.
